methodology.inputs: Same frozen selected-source files and artifact manifests for before and after.
methodology.before: v10 baseline packet behavior: exact-version excerpt filtering, with full excerpt bodies and the complete batch coverage lists.
methodology.after: Same sources and feature IDs; exact-substring ranked excerpt bodies are replaced by source references and unrelated artifact-list entries are filtered from the prompt map.
methodology.sourceProof: Unique planned source segments are reconstructed by original line range, encoded as UTF-8 and byte-compared to each selected file; all feature IDs must be present exactly once.
methodology.tokenEstimate: Character counts divided by four, rounded up, are rough estimates only; this is not provider tokenization or billable usage.
methodology.execution: Uses only the local TypeScript parser and deterministic static rules. Does not call a provider or execute repository code.
methodology.excluded: Provider framing, output tokens, live repair frequency, embedding provider usage and semantic quality are not measured here.
